tools.name: add_circle
tools.description: Adds exactly one circle and returns the permanent number assigned to it. Call this once per circle the user asked for; do not repeat the call after it succeeds. Fails if 6 circles already exist.

args.name: color
args.description: Colour for the new circle. Defaults to red if not given.

tools.name: remove_circle
tools.description: Removes exactly one circle, the one with this number. For every circle of a colour, call remove_circles_by_color once instead of calling this once per match. Other circles keep their own numbers, so a number from an earlier list_circles is still correct.

args.name: number
args.description: The circle's permanent number, as shown on it and reported by list_circles. Not a position, so do not assume the circles are numbered 1 upwards.

tools.name: remove_circles_by_color
tools.description: Removes every circle of one colour in a single call. Use it whenever the user asks for all the circles of a colour, instead of calling remove_circle once per match. Reports how many it removed; 0 means there were none of that colour, so say nothing was removed.

args.name: color
args.description: Every circle of this colour is removed. The circles of other colours stay.

tools.name: set_circle_color
tools.description: Changes the colour of one circle by its number, or of every circle if no number is given.

args.name: number
args.description: The circle's permanent number. Leave out to recolour all of them.

tools.name: list_circles
tools.description: Reports every circle on screen with its permanent number and colour. Numbers can have gaps. Call this first when the user names a circle by colour or position rather than by number. Removing every circle of a colour needs no numbers: remove_circles_by_color does it in one call.

tools.name: show_circle
tools.description: Opens this app with the circle of this number highlighted. Use it when the user asks to see or point out a circle rather than to change one.

args.name: number
args.description: The circle's permanent number, as shown on it and reported by list_circles. Not a position.
